meta.name: qdrant-migration-tool
meta.description: Guides use of the Qdrant Migration Tool CLI to move vectors, metadata, and sparse embeddings from another vector database into Qdrant. Use when someone asks 'how do I migrate from Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/pgvector/s3/Azure/Chroma/Redis/MongoDB/FAISS/Solr to Qdrant', 'move my vector database to Qdrant', 'is there a migration tool for Qdrant', 'my migration got interrupted, how do I resume it', 'migration is too slow', or 'collection wasn't created after migration'. Also use when picking migration batch size, deciding on `--net=host`, or verifying data after a migration.

copy.tagline: 把其他向量数据库里的向量、元数据和稀疏向量搬进 Qdrant
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正把 Pinecone、Weaviate 等向量库迁到 Qdrant
copy.tagline_en: Move vectors, metadata, and sparse embeddings from another vector database into Qdrant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving your vector database from Pinecone or Weaviate into Qdrant.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你用 Qdrant Migration Tool 这个 Docker 容器，把其它向量库的向量、元数据和稀疏向量搬进 Qdrant：按数据源选对应子命令、配置参数、续跑中断的任务、调批大小，并在迁移后做校验。
howto.when: 当你问如何从 Pinecone、Weaviate 等库迁到 Qdrant，或问到迁移中断怎么续跑、速度太慢、迁移后集合没建好时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 Pinecone 迁移到 Qdrant，该用哪个子命令？
say.note: 会给出对应子命令和凭据配置步骤。

say.text: 我的迁移中断了，怎么接着跑？
say.note: 会说明重跑同一条命令即可自动续传。

say.text: 迁移太慢，批大小该怎么调？

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the Qdrant Migration Tool Docker container to move vectors, metadata and sparse embeddings into Qdrant: choosing the source subcommand, resuming interrupted runs, tuning batch size, and verifying data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask how to migrate from Pinecone, Weaviate and other vector databases to Qdrant, or how to resume an interrupted migration, speed up a slow one, or fix a missing collection.

say_en.text: Which subcommand do I use to migrate from Pinecone to Qdrant?
say_en.note: Gives the source subcommand and credential setup.

say_en.text: My migration was interrupted—how do I continue it?
say_en.note: Explains that re-running the same command resumes.

say_en.text: The migration is too slow—how should I tune batch size?
say_en.note: Suggests raising batch size from 50 to 256 or 512.
